archetype: ARCHETYPE 5: LUXURY & CELESTIAL SACRED (Vedic Celestial + Trust Architecture)

rules.headings: DO NOT use Inter or Space Grotesk for Headings. Use Playfair Display or Cinzel with tight tracking (tracking-tight).
rules.body: Plus Jakarta Sans for high legibility in dense data and consultation forms.
rules.h1_max_size: text-4xl sm:text-5xl lg:text-6xl (Ceiling is text-6xl, never use text-8xl or text-9xl)
rules.hierarchy_gap: Jump between heading and subheading must not exceed 2 Tailwind scale steps.

spacing_and_layout.philosophy: Generous spacing philosophy (2-3x typical paddings). Containers with borders MUST have internal padding p-6 or p-8.

bento_grid_modes.marketing_discovery: MODE A: TETRIS GRID (col-span-full md:col-span-8 for hero, col-span-4 for featured verified astrologer, gap-8)
bento_grid_modes.dashboards: MODE B: HIGH DENSITY GRID (col-span-1 for stats, col-span-2 row-span-2 for chart/earnings ledger, gap-4 to gap-6)

spacing_and_layout.header: Fixed/Sticky Header with backdrop-blur-xl bg-[#0B0F19]/80 border-b border-amber-500/10 z-50. Must include Brand logo, 4 key nav links, role switch (Customer/Astrologer/Admin), and CTA button.

surface_styles.tracing_beam: Glowing golden gradient border highlight on active/featured astrologer cards
surface_styles.grid_borders: Subtle 1px border-[#2A3654] dividers between grid cells for admin dashboard tables

components_strategy.landing_and_marketing: Custom HTML + Tailwind CSS with rich cosmic visuals, gradient borders, micro-animations, starfield overlays.
components_strategy.interactive_forms_and_widgets: Shadcn UI components heavily customized with golden/cosmic theme.
components_strategy.dates_and_selects: Use Shadcn Popover + Calendar for birth chart (Kundli) & slot pickers. Use Shadcn Select for language & expertise filters.
components_strategy.data_tables: Shadcn Table with custom dense layout for Admin Verification Queue, Commission Reconciliation, Audit Logs, and Earnings Ledger.

motion_and_effects.animations: Framer Motion micro-interactions, subtle float for zodiac elements, smooth tab switching, entrance staggers for astrologer cards.
motion_and_effects.reduced_motion: Respect prefers-reduced-motion media query. Add aria-hidden='true' to decorative star particles.
motion_and_effects.transitions: Explicit property transitions like transition-all duration-300 or transition-[opacity,transform].

trust_and_compliance.disclaimer: Mandatory banner & footer statement: 'Astrology services are offered as interpretive guidance and spiritual insights, not guaranteed outcomes or legally binding predictions.'
trust_and_compliance.verification_badges: Distinct 'Identity Verified' (Government ID) vs 'Credential Verified' (Jyotish Acharya / Degree) badges with emerald #10B981 hover tooltip.
trust_and_compliance.refund_policy: Explicit terms snapshot in booking drawer: Full refund if cancelled > 2 hours prior or astrologer no-show.

customer: Birth Chart (Kundli) profile creation: Name, Date, Time of Birth, Place of Birth with auto-lat/long preview
Discover Astrologers Grid: Filter by Language (Hindi, Tamil, Telugu, English, etc.), Expertise (Vedic, KP, Nadi, Numerology, Tarot, Vastu), Price (₹/min), Experience (Years), Verified Badges
Astrologer Profile Detail: Bio, Credentials, Verified Badges, Consultation Modes (Chat ₹15/min, Audio ₹25/min, Video ₹40/min), User Reviews, Availability Calendar
Booking & Payment Flow: Time Slot selection, Birth Profile selection, Payment Gateway simulation with Wallet / UPI, Booking Receipt
Consultation Active Room (Chat Screen with mock timer, audio/video toggle, message history)
Customer Dashboard: Booking History, Wallet Balance, Saved Astrologers, Report/Block Astrologer, Account Settings & Account Deletion
astrologer: Astrologer Onboarding & KYC: Profile bio, languages, expertise, experience, document upload (ID proof & Jyotish Certificate)
Listing Subscription Plan Selection: Monthly ₹299 vs Quarterly ₹799 (with benefits highlight)
Rates & Availability Manager: Set per-minute rates for Chat/Audio/Video, toggle online status, configure weekly slot schedule
Astrologer Dashboard: Earnings Ledger (Gross, Commission deduction, Net Payout), Completed Sessions, Payout Request, Review Responses
admin: Admin Overview Dashboard: Total GMV, Active Consultations, Platform Commission (15-20%), Pending Verification Count
Verification Queue: Dual-stage approval (Identity Document approval + Astrologer Credential verification with document viewer modal)
Listing Plans Manager: Manage ₹299/monthly & ₹799/quarterly active subscriptions
Bookings & Financial Reconciliation: Transaction logs, Commission splits, Payout release button, Refund/Dispute resolution drawer
Reports & System Settings: Analytics, Commission percentage control, Terms configuration
Audit Logs Table: Immutable log of admin actions (approvals, refunds, rate changes)

testing_guidelines.rule: Every interactive element (buttons, tabs, inputs, cards, status badges, modals) MUST include a kebab-case data-testid attribute.

UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT: Ensure dark mode is default with warm celestial gold accents, but support light mode toggle seamlessly.
Do NOT center align .App or global containers. Follow structured, left-aligned standard visual rhythm.
All interactive elements must have micro-hover effects (shadow lift, border glow, text transition).
Strictly avoid emoji-only icons (🤖🧠💭💡🔮🎯); use Lucide or Phosphor React icons exclusively.
Ensure data-testid is attached to all buttons, links, inputs, tables, dropdowns, and status badges.
Support clear distinction between Customer View, Astrologer Portal, and Admin Console via role switcher or top navigation tabs for easy manual/automated testing.
All monetary amounts should be formatted in Indian Rupees (₹).
